mission.title: Overload
mission.description: Fight back the accelerated programs the intruder has turned loose across the city.

npc.say: Even these accelerated programs are no match for us, tesoro.

phase.briefing:
Operative, although his program overrides have posed problems for simulation stability, up to this point the intruder had not acted in a fashion that could be interpreted as intentionally and systematically hostile to the System. This has changed. The cause of his change in behavior is not known; in fact, we had just concluded a reasonably successful initial meeting with him.
However, the reality of the current situation must now be dealt with. Hostile, overridden programs have appeared across the city. All operatives are being mobilized to combat this threat.

enter.say: Seriously, are we surprised? A city-wide rampage was only a matter of time. I think these super-villain types have it in their contracts--that and evil laughter.
We've got accelerated program signals in there. Time to earn that paycheck.

phase.briefing: Operative, as the intruder himself does not appear to be present, we can assign combat programs to assist you. Please rendezvous with Agent Pace.

enter.say: Pace should be in-- Wait a second... I'm getting accelerated signals in there.

talk.say: {player}! Hostile programs are overrunning this location. We must eliminate them immediately.

done.say: I've got more accelerated signals in your vicinity!
Come, {player}! There is no time to waste!

Okay, I think you're clear.
Pace didn't get hurt, did she?

objective.text: Do not let Agent Pace die

phase.briefing:
I assume that you appreciate the urgency of the situation, operative.
You will have to proceed, even without backup.

enter.say: Hm... Long range scans showed accelerated activity in there, but I'm not picking up anything now.

done.say: Well, I guess the news today isn't all bad...

phase.briefing: I am less concerned about Exile casualties than the possibility that they may be turned against the System or the populace by override commands. Most sentient programs in the System will be vulnerable to the intruder's codes.

enter.say: I've got a massive override signal in there. Not sure I like the looks of this.

done.say: Ew. Is the intruder gonna go around accelerating just any old program? This could get to be a real pain.

mission.finish: Thank you, operative. Continued activity of this type by the intruder will place the entire simulation in jeopardy. I anticipate having another assignment for you shortly.
